concerns.text: FR-005 requires 'apply a multiple-comparison correction to statistical significance tests' and SC-003 requires significance 'measured against a corrected p-value threshold (α < 0.05 after multiplicity adjustment)'. Tasks.md lists this only as 'preserved work' (multiple-comparison correction in the status summary) with NO task or verification step producing an artifact demonstrating corrected p-values are computed and reported. T101's artifact list (tradeoff_curve.csv, threshold_report.json) contains no p-value/correction fields, and the tradeoff_curve schema has none. SC-003 has no demonstrable measurement in the task list.

concerns.location: tasks.md:'Dropped prior tasks' vs plan.md:Phase 5a / task 11 (T-Power-Simulation)
concerns.text: The plan's simulation-based power analysis (Phase 5a, '1000 simulated datasets... report estimated power') appears in NO task and is NOT listed under 'Dropped prior tasks (with cause)' — unlike T079/T051/T081, its removal is silent. A plan component is dropped without recorded justification, leaving an unexplained gap between plan and tasks.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Status summary ('GLMM-family analysis') vs plan.md:Decision/Rationale ('correcting the earlier mis-specified GLMM' to binomial GEE)
concerns.text: Tasks.md describes the preserved analysis as 'GLMM-family analysis' while the plan explicitly corrects the earlier mis-specified GLMM to a binomial GEE. The terminology drift risks an implementer preserving or reintroducing the mis-specified model when repairing T101. Use the plan's 'binomial GEE' terminology.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T109/T051 drop note vs plan.md:Phase 6/task 14/19 and data-model.md:Data Flow step 6
concerns.text: Tasks.md declares state/ platform-owned and publishes the reproducibility hash only under data/results/ (correct per constitution III), but plan.md (tasks 14/19, Phase 6) and data-model.md (Data Flow step 6) still instruct writing checksums to state/projects/...yaml. The tasks document should note that the plan/data-model text is superseded, or the plan should be amended — otherwise an implementer following plan.md reintroduces the T051 defect. Same for the src/ vs code/ layout (T079 drop vs plan Project Structure).
